title: Franky Finds the Ancient Mural in One Piece Episode 1168 Preview
content: ONE PIECE revealed the preview for Episode 1168, teasing Franky finding the ancient mural on Elbaph. The anime recently revealed a trailer for the Holy Knights of God , which teased voice ctor Kenjiro Tsuda as Shamrock. The character made his debut recently alongside Gunko , whose voice actress is Sumire Uesaka.
author: Anime Corner

title: Magical Sisters Lulutto Lilly Anime Reveals 2nd Part's October Debut, New Cast Member
content: Bandai Namco Filmworks announced on Sunday that the second cours (quarter of a year) of Mahō no Shimai Lulutto Lilly ( Magical Sisters Lulutto Lilly ), the new magical girl television anime that it is presenting with Studio Pierrot , will start in October.

title: Supporting Cast for 'Honoo no Toukyuujo: Dodge Danko' Announced
content: The official website of the Honoo no Toukyuujo: Dodge Danko revealed supporting cast and the main visual on Sunday. The anime, adapting Tetsuhiro Koshita 's sequel team sports manga , will premiere on Tokyo MX, MBS, and BS11 at 11:00 p.m. every Monday, beginning July 6.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Two Years Later, Jujutsu Kaisen Confirms The Most Anticipated Box Set
content: The highly anticipated Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4 is still at least a few months away since there’s no update on the release window so far. While the anime shared its first teaser during MAPPA’s 15th anniversary, more details will be revealed at a later date.
author: ComicBook

title: 'Higurashi no Naku Koro ni' New Anime Announced
content: Production company Kadokawa announced a new television anime for the Higurashi no Naku Koro ni ( Higurashi: When They Cry ) visual novel franchise on Sunday, revealing a teaser visual (pictured) and an announcement video.
